NTA NEET UG 2026 Admit Card | Re-Exam - Complete Details

NTA NEET UG 2026 Admit Card | Re-Exam. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 11/03/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 08/02/2026
  • Last Date : 11/03/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 11/03/2026
  • Exam Date : 03/05/2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Answer Key Date : 06/05/2026
  • Re Exam Admit Card Date : 14/06/2026
  • Re Exam Date : 21/06/2026
  • Fee Refund Start Date : 22-05-2026
  • Fee Refund Last Date : 27-05-2026 (11:50 PM)

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 08/02/2026
  • Last Date : 11/03/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 11/03/2026
  • Fee Refund Start Date : 22-05-2026
  • Fee Refund Last Date : 27-05-2026 (11:50 PM)
  • General : Rs. 1700/-
  • EWS / OBC NCL : Rs. 1600/-
  • SC / ST / PH (Divyang) : Rs. 1000/-
  • Post Name : Total Post
  • National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test UG 2026 : MBBS / BDS
  • Apply Fee Refund Process : Click Here
  • Download Fee Refund Notice : Click Here

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
